legs.detail: The 10:37 board line was 48.5. 60 clears both.
Board price was -148. He had 31 rush yards on a 62.5-yard projection and no catches.

lessons: The week lost money, and the loss was anytime touchdowns. Counting props (receptions, receiving yards, rush yards) hit 54–58% and were a few units ahead. Anytime touchdowns went 42-168, a 20% hit rate against a 26% sim probability, for -33.6 units.

Prices of +150 or longer were the hole:  those bets hit about 9 to 10 points below the sim in the +150 to +400 range. Dropping them from the card leaves the rest of the board at 166-146, +3.8 units, +1.2% ROI. That is why the published anytime probability for a yes price of +150 or longer is no longer allowed to sit above the posted price.

Nick's 10:37 top five were all those long anytime prices and went 0-5. The 7:05 list went 1-3 with Ladd McConkey void (absent from the box score) and Kyle Pitts at 0 touchdowns on 3 catches for 23 yards. Juwan Johnson was the only top-five touchdown that scored.

The Bears-Bucs parlay lost. Mayfield threw 243, so under 212.5 missed. Swift had 0 catches and 31 rush yards against a 64-yard rush projection. Williams (22 completions), Odunze (60 yards), and Burden (7 catches) hit.

Game scripts were not a small miss. Detroit-Miami finished 28 points against 49.5. Green Bay-New England finished 72 against 44.5. Houston-LA Chargers finished 66 against 40.5. Arizona-Seattle finished 20 against 39.5. Touchdown bets live or die with that.

Shedeur Sanders threw 297 yards against a 182 projection taken from his 2025 eight-game rate (2026 was three attempts). Drew Lock threw 175 against 206. One explosive start is not a large enough sample to refit quarterback yards, so that cap was left alone.

calibration.change: Anytime yes price of +150 or longer: published probability cannot exceed the posted implied probability.
calibration.week9_evidence: Anytime +150 or longer was the entire loss. The rest of the board was +3.8 units.
calibration.before: 45/55 blend with the price, then clamped within 3 points, which still ranked +220 to +310 anytime bets at the top.
calibration.after: Same blend, but a +150 or longer yes price is capped at the price itself, so it cannot rank as a plus-EV edge.
calibration.not_changed: 45/55 own-rate blend, no vacated-volume refill, rush committee, and quarterback yard caps. Pass-yard bias was only +3.6 yards. Receptions bias was -0.3.
calibration.backtest: The schedule backtest could not be rerun here: the local nflverse database file is empty, so there is no 2023–2026 game table to score. This change does not touch that simulator. It only stops a +150 or longer anytime price from being published above the price itself.
